issue.title: Re-measure gesture-settle reconcile churn over a week of post-deploy morning reviews

task_type_fields.proposal:
Proposed by bob-cli-q4.13 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #2) and required by the bob-cli-q4 plan's land-agent rule ("If the acceptance re-measure was partial, file a medium task to re-run the drift meter after a week of reviews and snooze it seven days").

Re-run `scripts/dev/reconcile-drift` (docs/develop/reconcile-drift.md) over the Bob vault for the window from the last settle deploy (Rust writers settled from 2026-11-25 19:30 EST; plugin gesture settles deployed through 2026-11-26: bob-ledger-tools 1.166.1, task-status-cycler 1.64.1, bob-navigation-hotkeys 2.107.11, block-id-prompt 1.46.0) to now, with at least three post-deploy morning reviews in the window. Compare against the 7-day baseline recorded on bob-cli-q4.4 note #1 (1650 introduced changes: 1007 status-group moves, 75 badge rows, 88 recurring-spawn flips, 53 LINKED FROM mention strips; tidy 0 of 602).

S4 targets: at most 2 gesture-attributable reconcile changes per morning review, and tidy stays at 0. For each residual note-local category, identify the gesture still missing its settle call (fix it if small, else file a follow-up through /sase_new_task); clock-driven and vault-wide categories are reconcile's by design. Record the table on this bead and note whether a gtd_daily.md grouping opt-out is still worth it (the epic ships none).
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The bob-cli-q4 acceptance phase could only observe one post-deploy morning review (S4 needs three), and the epic closes now; the re-measure needs a week of fresh vault history that does not exist yet.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-q4's acceptance re-measure was partial (one post-deploy morning review), so its plan requires a medium task to re-run the drift meter after a week and confirm the S4 churn target.

payload.description: Holds the 7-day reconcile-drift baseline table and JSON attachment to compare against
